title: A Big Week For Markets
gist: Gavekal's Will Denyer frames the week of 16 Nov 2026 as a stacked test of capital demand: Nvidia Q3 earnings as an AI-capex healthcheck, Anthropic's IPO pricing, and new US government spending asks (air traffic control upgrade, +US$350bn military) — all colliding with a Fed priced to hike in December and likely January, pushing 10-year Treasury yields to 5.14%. (Teaser only; the event-by-event analysis is paywalled.)

insights.claim: A cluster of large capital calls in the week of 16 November 2026 — Nvidia's AI capex healthcheck, Anthropic's IPO, an early US air traffic control upgrade and an extra US$350bn of military spending — lands when capital is already scarce, an ugly combination for bond markets.
insights.speaker: Gavekal Research
insights.so_what: Heavy simultaneous supply of equity, deficit spending and capex funding is a structural upward pressure on term premia; fade duration rallies while this calendar is live.
insights.quote: This is an ugly combination for bond markets
insights.locator: All this adds up to a lot of demand for capital

insights.claim: BlackRock CEO Larry Fink said in October 2026 that the US is "seeing genuine shortages of capital," a view Gavekal uses to frame the current rise in yields.
insights.speaker: Gavekal Research
insights.so_what: A capital-shortage regime favours lenders and owners of cash flow over long-duration borrowers; watch credit spreads and IPO pricing for confirmation.
insights.locator: All this adds up to a lot of demand for capital

insights.claim: US 10-year Treasury yields rose 32bp from their 5 November 2026 low to trade at 5.14% early on 16 November, with futures pricing a certain Fed rate hike in December and a probable further increase in January.
insights.speaker: Gavekal Research
insights.so_what: 10-year above 5% with a hiking Fed is a headwind for long-duration equities and AI-capex financing; key level to track around the week's events.
insights.locator: All this adds up to a lot of demand for capital

insights.claim: Where US bond yields and equity prices end the week of 16 November 2026 depends on how Nvidia's earnings, Anthropic's IPO pricing and Washington's spending requests play out.
insights.speaker: Gavekal Research
insights.so_what: Treat Nvidia results and Anthropic's IPO reception as joint sentiment gauges for AI risk appetite and for bond-market tolerance of capital demand.
insights.locator: Where bond yields and equity prices end this week

insights.claim: Nvidia's third-quarter earnings, reported on Tuesday 17 November 2026, are an important healthcheck on the AI capex boom, briefly diverting attention from former CEO Jensen Huang's personal scandal.
insights.speaker: Gavekal Research
insights.so_what: Nvidia is now trading under a leadership-change overhang; guidance on hyperscaler capex matters more than the headline beat.
insights.locator: This will be an eventful week for markets

insights.claim: Anthropic was set to price its IPO on Wednesday 18 November 2026 with shares beginning to trade on Thursday 19 November.
insights.speaker: Gavekal Research
insights.so_what: A large AI IPO absorbs capital and gives a public mark for frontier-AI valuations; its reception is a read-across for AI private markets.
insights.locator: This will be an eventful week for markets

insights.claim: After a Friday air traffic control system failure grounded US commercial flights, President Trump asked Congress to fund an early upgrade while also demanding immediate approval of an additional US$350bn in military spending.
insights.speaker: Gavekal Research
insights.so_what: Incremental fiscal asks add to Treasury supply; beneficiaries include defense primes and aviation-infrastructure contractors.
insights.locator: Meanwhile, after Friday's air traffic control
